notes: *neither* is read as the waw-plus-negative fusion of rule 35 rather than as a correlative pair, since the ASV writes no answering *nor*.
עָלַיִךְ in *spare thee* is silenced by the recasting to a bare direct object: the preposition is unrepresented under rule 40 and the suffix takes *thee*.
The closing clause writes its subject pronoun, so אֲנִי takes only *I* and the supplied *am* joins the predicate יְהוָה (rule 20).
